data.description: 阿里云语音服务 SDK（NLSClinet），是运行于 android 平台的基础语音识别、自然语言理解和语音合成的基础服务。语音 Android SDK 提供一句话识别服务，提供将实时短语音转成文字的功能，可直接用于语音搜索类应用。
data.label: 阿里云语音服务 SDK（NLSClinet）

data.description: Alibaba Cloud Speech Service SDK (NLSClinet) is a foundational service for speech recognition, natural language understanding, and speech synthesis running on the Android platform. The Speech Android SDK provides one-sentence recognition services, offering the ability to convert real-time short speech into text, which can be directly used in voice search applications.
data.label: Alibaba Cloud Voice Service SDK (NLSClinet)
